question: Ajụjụ
defaultDirections: Họrọ azịza ị chere zara ajụjụ ahụ. Mgbe ị mechara, pịa {checkAnswer}. Ị ga-enweta nzaghachi na-egosi ma azịza gị ziri ezi na otu esi aga n'ihu.
relatedContentDescription: Nke a na-emepụta mpaghara mechiri emechi maka ọdịnaya metụtara ajụjụ a, a na-egosikwa ya mgbe niile
hintDescription: A na-egosi nke a ma onye ọrụ zaa ajụjụ ahụ ezighi ezi
evidenceDescription: A na-egosi nke a ma onye ọrụ zaa ajụjụ ahụ nke ọma
numericDirections: Pịnye ọnụọgụ. A na-egosi gị nkeji ya. Mgbe ị mechara, họrọ {checkAnswer}.

authorViewTitle: Igodo azịza (naanị ndị ode akwụkwọ na-ahụ nke a)
formulaHelp: Ọnụọgụ, ma ọ bụ usoro na-eji mgbanwe ndị dị n'okpuru, dịka d / (t / 60). Usoro nwere ike iji + - * / ^, akara mkpọchi, sqrt() na abs().
tokensHelp: Gosi mgbanwe n'ime ajụjụ site n'ide aha ya n'ime akara mkpọchi, dịka {d}.
keyProblem: Enweghị ike ịgbakọ nke a ugbu a. Lelee na aha ọ bụla n'usoro ahụ bụ mgbanwe.
